blocks.text: COMMERCE GRENAVEL S.A. DE C.V. ("PublicidadActiva") is a company incorporated under Mexican law, whose purpose is to provide professional services in the field of digital marketing, with domicile in Mexico City; and, in accordance with the provisions of the Federal Law on the Protection of Personal Data Held by Private Parties ("LFPDPPP"), it undertakes to protect the Personal Data ("Data") of every person who enters the domain publicidadactiva.com.mx ("Website"). PublicidadActiva assumes responsibility for the use, handling and confidentiality of such Data through this Privacy Notice (the "Notice").

PublicidadActiva is dedicated to safeguarding the rights of privacy, intimacy and good reputation in the handling of personal data, always acting in accordance with the principles outlined in articles 6 (six) and 16 (sixteen) of the LFPDPPP.

In addition, PublicidadActiva reserves the right to update this Notice at any time. Modifications will be reflected by publishing the revised terms in the Services, and the "last updated" date will be adjusted accordingly, located at the top of the document.
1.- What personal data do we collect?

At PublicidadActiva we collect Data that you actively send us, and we may process your personal data with or without automated means, which includes the collection, organization, storage, analysis, consultation, use, disclosure by transmission, combination, restriction, deletion or destruction of the User's Data.
1. Data actively submitted

The User sends Data to PublicidadActiva when registering in our form, whose purpose is to start a dialogue that allows the exchange of information consisting of: (i) Full name; (ii) Email address; and (iii) Name of the Company where he/she works or owns.

When you visit our Website, information that the web browser sends each time you visit a website may be collected. Such information may include, by way of example and not limitation, your internet protocol address (IP address), browser type, operating system, language preference, any website you have previously visited that referred you to our site, date and time of each visitor request, information searched in our resources and other information collected by cookies or similar technologies. Please refer to the Cookie Preferences tool ("Cookie Tool") published on our Website to learn more about cookies, including the types of cookies and the specifications about the cookies we use. However, if you do not accept cookies, you will not be able to use some sections or features of our sites or applications, as described in the Cookie Tool.
2. What are the reasons we process personal data?

We process your Data for different purposes, however, the main ones are the following: (i) For the identification, knowledge and validation of the identity of Users who wish to join PublicidadActiva; (ii) to administer, operate and follow up on the Services contracted with PublicidadActiva; (iii) To send emails with information about the contracted Services; (iv) To answer questions, complaints, comments, requests and to provide customer service; (v) To comply with the obligations established by the LFPDPPP, as well as by the competent authorities. (vi) For market, advertising and/or commercial prospecting purposes; and (vii) For the use of customer and/or user testimonials for merely advertising and commercial purposes, referring to the Services offered by PublicidadActiva.

We may also use your personal data for internal purposes, such as auditing, data analysis, system troubleshooting and research. In these cases, we base our processing on the legitimate interest of carrying out PublicidadActiva's activities.
3. With whom do we share personal data?
We share your personal data with third parties in the following circumstances:

items: Third parties that are providers. PublicidadActiva may provide Data to third parties to process it in the performance of functions on our behalf as data processors (for example: payment processing, maintenance, security, data analysis, web hosting, measurement services, data-controlled social media messages, surveys, etc.). In such cases, in accordance with this notice and with the applicable legislation, providers will be contractually obligated to protect the Data against any further processing (including for marketing purposes) or transfer.

Legal requirements. PublicidadActiva may access and disclose your Data if we have a good faith reason to consider that doing so is required by a subpoena, a judicial or administrative order, or if required by Law in any other manner. In addition, we may disclose your personal information or other information as required by law or to exercise or defend legal rights; to take precautions to avoid incurring civil liability issues; to protect the rights, property or safety of the resource, of any person or of the general public; to maintain and protect the security and integrity of our services or infrastructure; to protect ourselves and our services from fraudulent, abusive or illegal uses; to investigate and defend against third-party claims or complaints; or to assist government law enforcement agencies.

blocks.text: 4. How do we protect personal data?

We apply technical and organizational measures to protect the Data we receive in order to prevent its loss, misuse and unauthorized alteration, and to protect its confidentiality. We periodically review our security procedures and consider new security technologies and appropriate methods.
5. How long do we retain personal data?

We retain the collected Data, including information collected, for a reasonable period in order to fulfill the aforementioned processing purposes. We then archive it for the period of time required by law or by other legal considerations. When archiving is no longer necessary, we delete the Data from our records.
6. How can you access and correct your personal data?

We strive to maintain the accuracy of the Data and rely on you to ensure that your personal data is complete and accurate. The User may exercise any of the Access, Rectification, Cancellation or Opposition rights (ARCO), which are listed and explained below:

items: Access: The User may request information about the personal data that PublicidadActiva has stored and how it is used.
Rectification: If the personal data that PublicidadActiva has is incorrect or incomplete, the User may request its correction or update.
Cancellation: If the User wishes their personal data to be deleted from PublicidadActiva's database, they may request its cancellation.
Opposition: The User has the right to oppose the processing of their personal data for specific purposes, such as sending commercial communications.

blocks.text: To exercise their rights, the User must send an email to atencion@publicidadactiva.com.mx, in free format addressed to PublicidadActiva and containing all the elements necessary to address the request. The ARCO request must contain and accompany what the LFPDPPP states in its Articles 29 and other related provisions, which are summarized as follows:

items: The name of the holder and address or other means to communicate the response to their request;
The documents that prove the identity or, where applicable, the legal representation of the holder;
The clear and precise description of the personal data with respect to which one of the aforementioned rights is to be exercised, and
Any other element or document that facilitates the location of the personal data

blocks.text: 7.- Competent Authorities.

If deemed necessary, PublicidadActiva informs the User that they have the right to go before the National Institute of Transparency, Access to Information and Protection of Personal Data (INAI) to assert any disagreement related to the processing of their personal data by PublicidadActiva.
8.- Contact us.
Queries regarding this Notice or the security of the Data we process can be sent through our email address atencion@publicidadactiva.com.mx.

At PublicidadActiva we strive to offer services of the highest quality, which is why our Refund Policy (the "Policy") is designed to provide clarity and transparency in the refund process, ensuring a fair and consistent experience for all PublicidadActiva clients.
1.- Reasons for Return, Cancellation and Refund.

items: Service Quality: The service offered by PublicidadActiva does not meet the promised or expected quality standards.
Inaccurate Description: The service or product does not match the description provided at the time of purchase.
Order errors: The performance of a service different from the one requested by the client.
Delivery Delays: Significant delays that affect the usefulness or relevance of the service to the client.
Lack of Correspondence: The service provided does not conform to the requirements established in the contract or order.

blocks.text: Likewise, in the event of any inconvenience with the service, such as non-compliance, inconsistency, partiality, defects or dissatisfaction on the part of the client or PublicidadActiva, cancellation of the service may be requested through a mutual agreement. In such circumstance, the amount retained as a guarantee may be refunded to the client, that is, the amount that has not been released to the professional by the client.

In the case of cancellation and refund to the client, the amount will be credited to the account registered with PublicidadActiva according to the payment method used in the original transaction. Subsequently, the client may choose to use the credit for future services or request the refund to their bank account.

The Client must comply with the payment process established by PublicidadActiva. If the Client sends the funds to PublicidadActiva and subsequently requests a cancellation through an external financial institution without first contacting PublicidadActiva, they will be responsible for the costs associated with such cancellation.
The right to a refund will only apply if the Client has made the payment for the Services as specified in the order, including all pertinent fees.
Any cost associated with processing the refund will be borne exclusively by the Client. These charges will be deducted from the total refund amount.
2.- Conditions for Refunds.
Depending on the Service offered by PublicidadActiva, the Client must meet the following conditions:

items: Refund Form: the Client must complete a Refund Form and send it to atencion@publicidadactiva.com.mx from the email address associated with their PublicidadActiva account.

Response: PublicidadActiva will process the Refund Form sent by the Client as soon as possible within a reasonable time frame. Response times may vary depending on the reasons for the refund and the workload. In any case, PublicidadActiva will inform the Client about the result of their request. The Client may also contact the support department, available 24/7, to obtain updates on their request.
If the client requests a refund, it will be made using the same payment method used in the original transaction.
Credit card payments: For payments made with a credit card in the last 15 to 30 days, the refund will be made to the same card.
Debit card payments: For payments made with a debit card in the last 10 to 15 days, the refund will be made to the same card.

Payments over 180 days: If the payment was made more than 180 days ago and the payment processor no longer allows refunds (variable depending on the processor, between 180 and 365 days), the refund will be made to the information provided by the client, as long as the data corresponds to the original holder of the purchase.

blocks.text: Notes: No refunds will be made if the Client has received the contracted services in accordance with their order and is completely satisfied with them. However, if the Client changes their mind and wishes to return the service already provided, PublicidadActiva will not be able to process the refund, since the service has been fulfilled as agreed.

In exceptional situations, PublicidadActiva reserves the right to evaluate each case individually and offer alternative solutions, such as adjustments to the services provided or credits for future projects.

If the payment method used has been canceled or replaced, the client must contact their service provider to verify how the refund will be managed in this case. We, as a process, send the refund information to the card operator.
3.- Contact and Support

For any queries related to our Policy or to request a refund, please contact our support team through the following email address: atencion@publicidadactiva.com.mx. At PublicidadActiva we are available to assist you and ensure that all your concerns are addressed efficiently.
